name: avatar-group
description: Overlapping avatar row + a "+N" overflow badge. Composition counterpart of the former control/avatar-group block — the overlap by negative margin, the overflow badge written statically.
provenPattern: Converted to a composition under the rule 'arrangement-only → template'.

knowledge.purpose: Represents a group on one line with a row of overlapping small avatars and a "+N" overflow badge
useCases: Showing a task's or document's participants at the end of the row
Summarising members on a team card without listing names
Showing participants densely on the comment/like row
antiPatterns: Showing more than five avatars — the arrangement was built for the overflow badge; a crowd is unreadable
Making avatars the only carrier of identity — the name must also exist as accessible text
Avatars that look clickable but go nowhere
